transient_overshoot_30m.interpretation: The prospectively locked transient conditions were too restrictive or absent in the week; they did not contribute to profit or loss.

failure_analysis.primary_failure: Common spot-perpetual participation and two-minute retained impact did not identify durable price discovery. At this horizon the same state frequently represented a synchronized terminal burst, inventory transfer or locally exhausted common shock.
failure_analysis.largest_performance_driver: The PERMANENT_DISCOVERY directional assignment. All material losses came from this branch; the transient branch produced no trades.
failure_analysis.frequency: Frequency was not the limiting problem. Removing the impact-retention gate raised central frequency from 2.86 to 3.29 trades per day but reduced win rate and increased drawdown.
failure_analysis.impact_retention: The retention threshold had useful selectivity but no independent positive expectancy. Its removal worsened performance, so it should remain a quality descriptor rather than be treated as causal proof of continuation.
failure_analysis.why_no_more_parameter_search: The central and both adjacent accepted-range horizons were deeply negative before and after the single ablation. Threshold tuning would fit a state whose directional interpretation has been directly falsified.

valid_components.why_useful: It produced enough causally observable opportunities for day trading and can anchor later state machines without assuming direction.

valid_components.component: cross-market spot participation and basis-share decomposition
valid_components.why_useful: It separates common shocks from derivative-specific dislocations and improved causal diagnosis, even though common shocks were not continuation signals.
It prevents overlapping continuation and reversal interpretations from being traded simultaneously.
It filters some low-quality events, but must be combined with external-liquidity location and failed-auction evidence before assigning direction.

next_hypothesis_requirements: Do not trade common spot-perpetual participation as continuation by itself.
Require the shock to reach a frozen external auction boundary before a scenario exists.
Use failure to extend and completed reclaim of the frozen boundary to identify absorption or terminal execution.
Separate persistent-flow absorption from active flow reversal, but allow both to express the same failed-auction direction only after reclaim.
Use the opposite side of the frozen accepted range as the natural liquidity objective and the observed sweep extreme as invalidation.
Preserve NautilusTrader-only execution, 3% current-NAV risk and first-week-to-second-week sequential gates.
